T: One very long day in New York. Snacks for the road.
D: John McClane and a Harlem shopkeeper race around the city solving a bomber's riddles.
P: Pour drinks when McClane gets the water jug puzzle.
S: whatever's on the counter in Harlem
Liquorice, jelly beans and chocolate bars tipped into a big bowl, a few salted peanuts through it.
Buttermilk-soaked chicken thigh pieces dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 175C until crisp, served on hot waffles with butter and honey spiked with hot sauce.
grabbed on the run between riddles
Pastry turnovers filled with curried beef mince, turmeric pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
M: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll
Crisp bacon, a fried egg with a broken yolk and American cheese melted on top, in a buttered toasted kaiser roll, salt, pepper and ketchup.
Lamb shoulder roasted with oregano and lemon, shaved thin and crisped in a pan, on rice with tzatziki, tomato, onion and warm pita.
W: Butter cake topped with a thick cinnamon crumble, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, icing sugar.
K: fill one jug and solve the puzzle
Fresh lemonade (lemon juice, sugar syrup, cold water) in a big jug, with a 5 and a 3 litre jug to work out exactly 4 litres.

edition.tagline: One very long day in New York. Snacks for the road.
edition.cue: Pour drinks when McClane gets the water jug puzzle.

s.note: Liquorice, jelly beans, chocolate and salted peanuts in one big bowl.
s.how: Tip 150g liquorice, 150g jelly beans, 4 chocolate bars broken into chunks and 100g salted peanuts into a big bowl and mix. Put it on the counter, the way it sits in Zeus's shop.

s.note: Buttermilk fried chicken on waffles with hot honey.
s.how: Soak 600g boneless chicken thighs in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Dredge in 200g flour with 1 tsp paprika and fry at 175C for 7 minutes until 74C inside. Cook 8 small waffles from a 300g mix. Warm 100ml honey with 2 tsp hot sauce and drizzle over the chicken on the waffles.

m.n: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll
m.note: Crisp bacon, fried egg and melted cheese in a toasted roll.
m.how: Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Fry 4 eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of American cheese on each to melt. Split and butter 4 kaiser rolls and toast them. Fill with 2 rashers bacon and an egg each, season with salt and pepper and add tomato sauce.

w.note: Butter cake under thick cinnamon crumble and icing sugar.
w.how: Rub 100g plain flour, 100g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 80g cold butter into big crumbs. Beat 125g butter with 125g caster sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour with 100ml milk. Spread in a lined 20cm tin, cover with the crumble and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Fresh lemonade in a big jug, measured to exactly four litres.
d.how: Dissolve 300g caster sugar in 300ml hot water and cool. Add 400ml lemon juice, about 10 lemons, and top up with cold water to exactly 4 litres. Work it out with a 5 litre and a 3 litre jug if you're feeling brave. Serve over ice.
